title: Midnight Hunt Commander: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: She keeps the festival's revels from faltering, infusing the witches' rituals with hope.
"Even when the angels succumbed to madness, Sigarda stood strong. She is hope."
"I was going to suggest silver, but a beam of pure angelic fury works even better." —Rem Karolus, Fiendslayer
Whether you'll fit in isn't up to you at all.
"Hold on tight, little one. I'll get you to safety."
"Festival's just ahead. You're almost there!"
Furious and unable to separate, the bitter rivals consoled themselves by splitting everything else they saw in half.
"Within our minds are limitless depths. Dive down, but don't forget to surface." —Teferi
The patrol found the graf empty save for a few well-chewed bones.
The Harvesttide dance is one of joyous abandon, a last revel before winter nights.
Clare realized too late why no one ever took the shortcut through the abandoned mill.
"When angels fall, humans must rise."
The gourd carving was supposed to take place *after* the feast.
"We fight together! In Sigarda's name, ready your weapons!"
They had no marble, so the faithful repaired her likeness with wood, straw, twine, and clay.
He ripped up board after board until his hands were bloody. Still, he could not find whatever it was he sought.
The fastest way across the dunes is above.
"Hold the line, for family and the fallen!"
"Justice isn't done until undeath is undone."
"As long as I stand, so will your cause."
In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.
"Never forget our ancestors. They have not forgotten us." —Mikaeus, the Lunarch
Those who are chosen do not doubt. Those who remain do not lament.
"Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."
The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.
Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.
The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.
Her paean is the clash of spears, her prayer a battle cry.
"Don't worry, there's plenty for everyone." —Vickon, Eleventh Company battlemage
Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.
"My earliest work escapes me." —Stitcher Geralf
"So many corpses, so little time."
To serve as an eternal is the afterlife granted to the worthy.
"Let those idiot priests tremble! A new era in unlife begins here and now. Oglor, raise the lightning vane!" —Stitcher Geralf
Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.
His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.
Every grave cradles a recruit.
Even when the flesh grows cold, knowledge waits in the bones for a master to release it.
Countless ghouls surged through Thraben's streets, and with them came the city's salvation.
For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.
"Did you have a nice nap?" —Liliana Vess
Gods can be appeased. Demons, however . . .
With Thraben's army recalled to its city walls, outlying villages were left to fend for themselves.
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise." —Skyclave inscription
Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.
Having flesh is increasingly a liability on Mirrodin.
The Cabal never expected its creations to create servants of their own.
Liliana inspires horror in many and fanatical admiration in a few.
"There are so many of them. It seems they've just been waiting for someone to serve."
The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.
No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.
It was a night like any other. It would soon become a night no one would ever forget.
"I know they're unstoppable fighters created to harvest souls—it's just they're so rude about it." —Kaya
Necromancers deal in commodities far more precious than gold and grain.
"To see past the veil of death, cross it." —*The Red Book of Mezdrithalik*
"There will come a day so dark you will pray for death. On that day your prayers will be answered." —Minaldra, the Vizag Atum
"Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them." ―Euphemia, Nexus watcher
"My battle cry reaches ears far keener than yours." —Saidah, Joraga hunter
"To survive exceptional times we must adapt by exceptional means." —Vannifar
"We traffic in flesh, not souls. Still, it's a shame to let anything go to waste." —Cevraya, Golgari shaman
She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.
"Now is the hour. Ours is the duty. For victory and family—charge!"
"They put bars on these noble beasts and then wonder why werewolves target our towns."
First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.
"You can face any danger when all of nature is on your side."
"When they covered the world in city, all they did was give themselves nowhere to run."
Though its mind has long since rotted away, it wields a sword with deadly skill.
Only the sun that beats down upon Arashin's walls could shine more brightly.
"These fiends are slightly less tolerable than you." "A sentiment that warms my heart, sister."
Sigarda was the last uncorrupted archangel, but she would not have to fight alone.
To protect the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya, they trained in the ways of both.
"Bring forth the dead, their skull-grins and rattle-bones. We will feast upon their wailing ghosts." —Silumgar, translated from Draconic
It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.
The essence of night to harden the soul.
It harmonizes with the essence of its master.
"Inspiration is found by looking outward." —Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter
The essence of wind to lift up the weary.
Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared." —Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords
The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind." —Gadwick, the Wizened
Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them." —Pulan, Bant orchardist
Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.
On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.
On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas." —Kiora
